name: everyday wear
what: regular wear for daily life: uni, work, errands. durable finishes, low profile, nothing that snags

name: stacks
what: stackable pieces meant to be combined: thin bands, low profile, curated stack sets. stackability is a geometric fact (band width, height profile) owned by paracraft validation, never a self-declared tag
notes: a creator can publish a stack set: a curated group of pieces designed to combine; the set references release ids, and each member must be individually stackable per geometry

name: special occasion
what: statement and formal pieces for events: going out, ceremonies as a guest, gifts

name: ceremony and commitment
what: wedding and commitment pieces; overlaps the symbolic bases (promise, claddagh, affinity) already specified in configure
